children: President Donald Trump on Saturday said he will form an “AI Force” and appoint an AI “czar” in a bid to control the harmful side of artificial intelligence, an industry he said will one day make up 25% of the U.S. GDP.
“We will not in any way hinder or stifle the Growth of this incredible Industry. Rather, we will cherish it, help it, and watch over it as it grows!" Trump said in a social media post.

“AI is the next Industrial Revolution, or Internet, but will be even larger and more impactful, possibly as much as 25% of our Country’s GDP,” he added, noting that the U.S. is leading China and other countries in AI, and “I intend to keep it that way!”
“However, we will also be looking for BAD, and we can do that, very easily, with our already existing Criminal and Civil Justice System,” Trump said, announcing plans to establish an AI force.

Trump said his AI force will be similar to the Space Force, which he established during his first term and “has been a tremendous SUCCESS.” “To that end, I will be announcing, in the near future, the AI 'Czar'—Only high-I.Q. individuals need apply!,” he said.

title: Trump to form “AI Force”; says AI will make up 25% of U.S. GDP
